entry.title: Big-Eared Brown Bat Vessel
entry.blurb: The vessel depicts a member of the Histiotus mochica species , a big-eared brown bat that researchers described in 2021 and, due to this vessel, named in honor of the Moche, also known as the Mochica.

source.credit: The Cleveland Museum of Art. John L. Severance Fund

facts: Moche bat symbolism may be linked to the animal’s paradoxical traits—for instance, bats fly but have fur rather than feathers.
Such traits may have caused the Moche to link bats with transitional states, such as the passage between life and death.

Such traits may have caused the Moche to link bats with transitional states, such as the passage between life and death.
